n2691e1871f.headline: Resilience Budget: S$15.1b Jobs Support Scheme to help companies
n2691e1871f.summary: The government will allocate S$15.1 billion to the Jobs Support Scheme, co-funding wages to help companies keep 1.9 million local employees in work. The measure is part of the Resilience Budget.
n2691e1871f.why: Government wage support affects corporate costs and employment, and is a key fiscal lever for the Singapore economy.

n727275ffd3.headline: Tourism establishments demand members provide numbers of employees and their salaries to negotiate their compensation
n727275ffd3.summary: The Chamber of Tourism Establishments in Egypt requested members to provide employee numbers and salary details to facilitate compensation negotiations during the COVID-19 crisis.
n727275ffd3.why: Tourism is a major sector in Egypt's economy, and labor cost management amid the pandemic affects business viability and employment levels.
